featureDoc.recentDmg: sum of dmgTaken over this tick and the previous 4, / hpMax, capped at 1
featureDoc.recentHit: 1 if any dmgTaken > 0 over this tick and the previous 4
featureDoc.npcCount: number of named NPCs in the scene / 10, capped at 1
featureDoc.nearestDist: distance to the nearest NPC / 10, capped at 1 (30 if no NPC)
featureDoc.nearestAtkMe: 1 if the nearest NPC is interacting with the local player
featureDoc.nearestHasHp: 1 if the nearest NPC's health ratio >= 0 (health bar visible)
featureDoc.attackersOn: count of NPCs interacting with the player / 5, capped at 1
featureDoc.attackerAdjacent: 1 if any NPC interacting with the player is within 1 tile
featureDoc.hasTarget: 1 if the player is interacting with an NPC
featureDoc.moving: 1 if the player's world position differs from the previous tick

verdict.metric: held-out log loss (baseline - model; > 0 = model better)
verdict.reason: held-out slice holds 0 positive labels (< 20) — no verdict is measurable on this corpus, whatever the loss says
